admission_apply.text: You draw breath across the split. A thin note rises, a shade too high, and stops when you stop. Only that.

native.admission_inspect: A pale reed, split along the grain. The crack is dry and narrow. You are not sure it was always this slight.
apply_texts: Again the tone rides high of your intent. You blame the crack. The blame fits, slips, and fits too well.
Breath across the split gives a thin, high note, not the one you shaped. The crack is warm for a moment.
Grain, moisture, a split. Still the tone lifts higher than the last. You keep no reason, only the rise.
The high note arrives before the breath is finished. You did not ask for it. The wood is warmer than it should be.
The note leaves your mouth already high. You nearly name why. The name fails, and the pitch does not.
The wrong high note is in the air as your lip touches wood. Attention made it sharper, not truer.
You draw breath across the split. A thin note rises, a shade too high, and stops when you stop. Only that.
You force the pitch down to the tone you meant. It holds. You are no steadier for it, and the distrust remains.
You know the error and produce it sooner. The split does not teach. It repeats, higher, and will not be corrected.
inspect_texts: A pale reed, split along the grain. The crack is dry and narrow. You are not sure it was always this slight.
Moisture darkens the split. The last tone, too high by a little, hangs in the ear though the reed is silent.
The split looks wider than the reed can spare. You blink, and it is only a pale crack again. You blink once more.
The split seems to hold a high note. A crack cannot hold a note. Your eye returns, and the fancy returns with it.
You have worried this crack before. It looks no wider, and yet your thumb expects a gap the wood does not give.
You hesitate over another breath. The split is darker where the last one went. Under the thumb it is only a line.
native.name: Pale Split Reed
